# Vanylven Sauna

> A small public sauna on the shore of the Vanylvsfjord in Fiskå, Vanylven municipality (Møre og Romsdal, Norway), below Fiskå Brygge Gjestgiveri. Built by Stad Kystbygg and run by local volunteers. Private sessions for up to 8 people, and an open sauna on Wednesday evenings. Sea swimming straight from the shore.

Key facts:

- Location: 6143 Fiskå, Vanylven, Norway. GPS 62.09730, 5.55777.
- Private session: NOK 600 for 2 hours for the whole group (up to 8 people). Thursday to Sunday, 10:00 to 20:00, last start 18:00. Book online.
- Open sauna: NOK 100 per person, every Wednesday 17:00 to 20:00. No booking, pay on arrival.
- Payment: Vipps (943550) or bank transfer.
- Contact: vanylvensauna@gmail.com, or Messenger on the Facebook page. No phone.
- Languages: English and Nynorsk.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://www.vanylvensauna.no/): the sauna, a visit step by step, prices, booking, rules, questions and answers

## Questions and answers

- **How much does the sauna cost?** A private session costs NOK 600 for 2 hours, for the whole group of up to 8 people. Open sauna on Wednesday evenings costs NOK 100 per person.
- **When is the sauna open?** Private sessions run Thursday to Sunday, 10:00 to 20:00, with the last start at 18:00. Open sauna is every Wednesday, 17:00 to 20:00. For other times, email vanylvensauna@gmail.com or message us on Messenger.
- **How do I book?** Pick a free time in our booking calendar, then pay with Vipps or bank transfer. Open sauna on Wednesdays needs no booking: just come.
- **How do I pay?** With Vipps (943550) or by bank transfer. Write the date and your name in the message so we can find your booking. How to pay, step by step.
- **How do I get in?** When your payment is in, we email you the door code the day before your visit.
- **Can I swim in the sea?** Yes. The sauna sits on the shore of the Vanylvsfjord in Fiskå, so you can cool off in the sea between rounds. Sauna and swimming are at your own risk.
- **What should I bring?** Swimwear, your own towel to sit or lie on, and plenty of water to drink. No alcohol, inside or outside.
- **Can children come?** Yes. Children under 16 come with an adult.
- **Can I cancel?** Cancel by email or Messenger at least 24 hours before your session and it costs nothing. Later cancellations cost NOK 300.
- **Do you sell gift cards?** Yes, for 2, 4 or 6 hours, valid for one year. Design the card online, pay with Vipps or bank transfer, and we send it to you. To use one, book as usual and email us the card number instead of paying.
- **Where is the sauna?** On the shore below Fiskå Brygge Gjestgiveri in Fiskå, Vanylven, in Møre og Romsdal, not far from Stad. Map and directions.
- **Who runs the sauna?** Vanylven Sauna was built by Stad Kystbygg and is run by volunteers from Vanylven.
